visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman in a pink sleeveless top and dark denim shorts is kneeling on a light-colored wooden floor in a modern living room. She is adjusting her hair into a ponytail while a toddler in a pink shirt crawls nearby. The background features a large window with a view of high-rise city buildings under a cloudy evening sky. (2) A man's hand enters from the lower left, holding a boxed product called VAGO. The woman takes the box and holds it up to the camera, pointing at the small white vacuum device inside. The room is brightly lit with warm indoor lights, and a gray sofa is visible on the left. (3) The woman opens a large clear plastic vacuum bag and begins stuffing a large beige teddy bear and a pink fluffy pillow into it. She is focused on the task, kneeling on the floor. On the right, an open silver suitcase sits ready on the floor, surrounded by other packed items. (4) The small white VAGO device is attached to the valve of the vacuum bag. The woman presses a button, and the bag slowly begins to shrink as the air is removed. A split-screen visual comparison is shown briefly to emphasize the compression power of the device. (5) The woman claps her hands together and smiles widely at the camera, expressing her satisfaction. Two bags are laid out on the floor—one is thick and uncompressed, while the other is thin and flat. The toddler continues to play on the floor nearby. (6) The woman picks up the highly compressed bags and places them neatly into one side of the silver suitcase. She demonstrates that the vacuumed items now take up significantly less space than before. The man's hand appears again, giving a thumbs-up gesture of approval.
